title: Optional carries filter, tap, isSome, and isNone with the meanings the type system page requires
notes: specification/type-system.mdx, 'Optional', requires operations equivalent in purpose to isSome, isNone, match, map, andThen, filter, tap, unwrap, unwrapOr, toResult, toNullable, all. The single trailing 'tap Ada' line is load-bearing: tap fired on the present value and did not fire on the absent one.
